_description: South Carolina top-rate sunset: 6% through 2026, 5.2% from 2027 via successor profile. Same pension, same year-1 vs year-2 financial inputs — observable difference in state tax.
_rationale: Single, SC, ages 60–61. $80k pension before-tax, no spending goal (surplus goes to reinvestment), zero growth/inflation/stddev. Federal tax on $80k (age 60, no senior add-on yet) = federal tax(80k − 16,100 std ded = 63,900) = 10%·12,400 + 12%·38,000 + 22%·13,500 = 1,240 + 4,560 + 2,970 = $8,770. SC: pension is `before_tax` ordinary, not Traditional withdrawal → SC's $10k retirement exclusion (65+) doesn't apply (age < 65 and not Trad). State base = $80k − $14,000 SC std ded = $66,000. Year 1 (2026): SC 6% × $66k = $3,960. Year 2 (2027): SC successor 5.2% × $66k = $3,432.
name: SC 2026→2027 transition
